environment_proposals.name: Program workshop
environment_proposals.purpose: Study recovered routines, maintain instruments, process supplied metal and reuse heat.
environment_proposals.evidence: Card reader, padded recovered cards, charge gauge, separate feeds, hot cup, output tray, water route and spent substrate.
environment_proposals.link: Artificers/Founders repair practice, Archivists' procedures and Keepers' licensed cultivation.
environment_proposals.gap: Which parts of the copied procedure are essential, and which are inherited caution?

environment_proposals.name: Proving yard
environment_proposals.era: Present-day facility on inherited Anchor terraces
environment_proposals.purpose: Compare useful spell behavior against ordinary matter before field use.
environment_proposals.evidence: Charred oak, chipped stone, jointed practice devices, conduction rack, culture beds, refractory processing and marked receiving platforms.
environment_proposals.link: Workshop service interfaces; maintenance traditions of the Anchor offices.
environment_proposals.gap: How much of the recovered equipment can its maintainers safely reproduce? The art does not answer this.

sources: source_brief.txt (byte-preserved user attachment; implementation phases used as art direction)
lore_constraints: Wands are held circuits; cards are stored routines; sparks and useful work have finite inputs.
Resonant crystal is salvaged/repaired in these scenes, not manufactured from scratch.
Do not explain or depict the Surveyors, ninth office, return sender or occupants above.
Office attributions and new facilities are artistic proposals, not additions to canon.

changes: Replaced orange lightning-like biological effects in the first-person growth panel with matte roots and fern shoots.
Replaced the same visual error in the proving-yard culture bed and clarified a localized protective-field hit response.
strengths: Twelve deliberately different equipment silhouettes and material constructions.
Restrained shared palette and emission limited to useful active parts.
Local material consequences and separate post-effect views.
Finite feeds and supplied process stock shown in machinery concepts.
remaining: Inventory images are concept interpretations, not hand-cleaned pixel sprites at a verified native resolution.
A static impact/frost illustration does not unambiguously prove trigger ordering; timer, recursive and conditional behavior still need animation studies and runtime verification.
The conduction scene suggests connected routes but is not a validated electrical diagram.
The protective-field bay is a layout proposal, not a safety or physics validation.
Water/freezing transitions and exact voxel sizes require implementation-specific review; no resolution-transition correctness is claimed.
No 100-appearance procedural catalog, dropped-item pass, full lighting comparison or animation pack has been authored in this batch.

production_boundary: Original imagegen concept references. No Blender sources, production meshes, shipping textures, engine changes, tests, gameplay demonstrations, performance measurements or acceptance/parity claims.
recovery_note: Automatic saving of proving_yard_v1 returned an empty local PNG. The exact unmodified PNG bytes returned by imagegen were saved to the workspace from their base64 transport; no pixels were edited outside imagegen.
